steps.title: Prepare Samples for Extraction
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample based on the extraction type using CTAB solution.

substeps.instruction: For HA filter extraction: Thaw the sample on ice.
For BCoV/BRSV extraction (in duplicate): Add 5 µL of BCoV/BRSV solution to a 2-mL tube containing 250 µL CTAB, vortex for 15 seconds (speed 7/10), and flash freeze the tube.
For Direct extraction: Add 150 µL of wastewater to a 2-mL tube containing 100 µL CTAB, vortex for 15 seconds (speed 7/10), and flash freeze the tube.

steps.title: Perform Bead Beating (HA Filter Only)
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt HA filter samples using a high-energy cell disrupter.

substeps.instruction: Place 2-mL tubes in the Mini-Beadbeater-16 (BioSpec, 607, 1 speed).
Bead beat for 00:02:30, starting the timer when the beads start to be loose in the tubes.
Cooldown the samples on ice for 00:05:00.
Repeat the bead beating and cooldown cycle once.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples to separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed (150,000 rpm) for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer Supernatant to Lysis/Bind Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the appropriate volume of supernatant to the Lysis/Bind plate.

substeps.instruction: For HA filter extraction: Transfer 125-250 µL of supernatant (use 125 µL for 'dirty' influents from WWTPs, otherwise default to 250 µL).
For BCoV/BRSV/Direct extraction: Transfer all supernatant.

steps.title: Collect and Store Purified Sample
steps.instruction: Recover the purified nucleic acids from the Elution plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the purified sample from the Elution plate to microcentrifuge tubes.
Store RNA extract in RNase-free water at -80ºC for up to 1 year.
